paragraphs.text: The Cauldron of Eternity is a magical artifact found on the plane of Eldraine .

The Cauldron of Eternity is a massive stone bowl with metal legs, large enough to accommodate a human's body. Its interior has rocky, gem-like sides that give off a crystalline purple glamour. The Cauldron grants eternal youth and can revive those who die, deeming them worthy. It used to be housed at Locthwain before it vanished, and many knights of that court have quested in the Wilds , sometimes for years at a time, to find it.

When it finally reappeared, summoned by an act of persistence of Will Kenrith , the Cauldron was used to free Garruk Wildspeaker of the Chain Veil 's curse and to return him to life. A voice that squeezed the heart called Garruk worthy .
